inbox.label: Support inbox
inbox.help: How the inbox works (Support → Inbox). "Per page": how many conversations one page of the list shows. "Longest reply": the most characters a reply or an internal note may have. "Take it on reply": a reply to a conversation nobody has taken makes you its owner. "Waiting after a reply": your reply moves the conversation to "Waiting for the customer" until the customer writes again.

attachments.label: Files in a conversation
attachments.help: Files the team may attach to a reply or a note. Files a customer sends are always kept. "Files per message": how many one message takes. "Largest file": in megabytes. "Kinds": pictures, videos and PDFs; each file is checked by its contents, not its name.
